name: Generated Rust future callback inline re-entry regression
summary: Actual generated Rust future poll/complete/free regression fails after a bounded three-second callback re-entry deadlock on UniFFI0.28.3 and passes on0.32.2. Dependency and generated bindings updated using maintained generators. New non-Copy Handle requires clone() at FFI boundaries; callback/future behavior is unchanged. Original0944/1116 causes remain unconfirmed.

assertions.evidence: 0.28.3 actual generated ABI test failed at3.01s with the exact callback re-entry deadlock panic.
0.32.2 actual generated ABI test passed one parent test at0.01s with no failures or skips.
Native1248 captured HTTP200 finish57.646ms plus callback/inline-resume/nested-poll blocked on the old scheduler mutex.

scope: Local maintained regression and debug-native preparation only; no signed-candidate, automatic CI, physical-phone or Play acceptance.
note: Child isolation executes the same test within the one parent Cargo testcase; do not count nested output as a second acceptance test.
